articles.summary: Every state — and even some cities — has its own vacation and sick leave rules. Every's new Time Off product tracks accruals, approvals, and payouts inside the same platform as payroll, with compliance AI that researches the rules across your census and recommends a policy built around the strictest requirement.
articles.title: New: Tracking Your Employees' Time Off

articles.summary: After-school programs, scout trips, and fundraisers are the heartbeat of local communities. But financial planning for local events can be complicated. Learn how Lee "Zap" Bond is building Gauge, a payments platform for groups and communities.
articles.title: Inside Lee "Zap" Bond's Journey Building Gauge: A Payments Platform for Groups and Communities
